patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Adapt.io only if your buying job matches “Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Cust” rather than Outreach's shape. Choose Outreach only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packa” rather than Adapt.io's shape. Workflow advantage: Adapt.io leans data-enrichment, contact-management; Outreach leans sales-engagement, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Adapt.io and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Adapt.io is Regional B2B contact database with credit plans — Free; Starter $49/mo; Basic $99/mo; Custom contact sales; 7-day trial.; Outreach is Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packages; request pricing (seat + AI credits)..
- Company-size focus: Adapt.io (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Outreach (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adapt.io-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs Outreach-leaning sales-engagement, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Adapt.io — Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; Outreach — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Adapt.io: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches; No native email sequencing — data/export first; Outreach: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — enterprise quote only.

Poor-fit cases: Adapt.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Thinner global mega-database depth than UpLead/Hunter/Apollo-class peers for many buyer niches · Outreach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Adapt.io if you actually need Outreach's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
